titleEn: Seasonal campaigns (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday) playbook

undo.note: each template is submitted to Meta

en: Help me plan a Ramadan campaign

steps: The owner (or the assistant, after the confirm button) submits the three Ramadan templates (greeting, offer, opening hours) to Meta for approval
Nothing is sent to a customer: the templates are used afterwards through a normal campaign, with the consent, content and frequency gates
edgeCases: Names that already exist are skipped; Meta may reject a template, see the rejection guide
Holiday opening hours for the bot are the existing hours setting (Bot > hours): the pack never states a time of its own
gaps: No button on the Templates screen yet: the assistant (confirm card) or the route
assistantNote: submits templates to Meta; irreversible; sends nothing to customers
